notes.title: V0.9.10 Update: Custom Naming Function Now Available!
notes.content:
Hey gamers! It's VaMP here. In this update, we've added the custom naming function for Mod configurations and optimized the game performance.

[h2]New Additions[/h2]
Language selection now pops up when you first enter the game (will also appear for veteran players who haven't selected a language before)
Added custom naming function for Mod configurations
Added feature to remove all Mods
Added operation menu in the Mod interface, including options to increase capacity, custom naming, and remove all Mods



[h2]Optimizations/Adjustments[/h2]
Display airdrop status on the HUD
Game now automatically pauses during battles if the player switches out
New treasure chests will now periodically refresh on the battlefield
Optimized map interface animations, added stage selection arrow
Enhanced Mod preview panel display in the battle style selection interface
Enhanced Mod preview panel display in the equipment interface
Enhanced the display of the upgraded options panel in the pause menu
Enhanced some game sound effects and visual effects

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/6c21c9c4c47aa6e87927de896ecec6b30da5cc7a.png[/img]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
Fixed issue where enemy bullets hitting the player would display the damage effect in the wrong position
Fixed issue where the Resupply Commander's passive skill increased airdrop cooldown instead of decreasing it

[h1]Time Machine back to all modes
[/h1]

[h2]About the Time Machine
[/h2]

In our 0.7.80 Update, we added tactical supplies, which allows you to purchase tactical supplies when you are close to the landing pod. The store contains some special items at the expense of some G-crystals, such as the [b]Time Machine[/b].

My original intent for the Time Machine was, under advice of many players, to pass through the livelong mid-game in Endless Mode quickly.

In a non-Endless Mode game, the mission was not designed that long, and use Time machine earlier will cause players be overwhelmed by monsters in a sudden, and a late usage (usually after the mission time, the Time Machine effect still being activated) may cause game bugs. All those factors forced me to make a hard decision to ban it temporarily.

I am currently trying to fix the bug. Time Machine will come back to non-Endless Modes in the next patch. I am really sorry for all the inconvenience it caused.

Thank you so much for your understanding and support to me, and to Greedland.

notes.title: V0.7 Major Update
notes.content:

[list]
[*] Unlock Endless Area in Jungle, Desert and Tundra.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/84b5aed329bf16cdd07503288a01a2bcb6be0400.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/64a2f67f9f7bbe4e51cc7237a2998bb29e9c6e6f.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/39a3a2854ef2139934aecef12a68ebe032dd5275.gif[/img]

[*] New Weapon - Moonbeam: The fan-shaped Moonbeam possesses strong penetrating power and will damage all enemies in its path.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/3eeabed79ab9ba9b8566e60b97616494a0a4916f.gif[/img]

[*] New Mod - Last Stand: The lower your health, the higher your damage. [Check achievement list for acquisition]
[*] Map UI Enhancement: Display advanced mission information.
[*] Added the feature to skip upgrade information pop-up. This feature can be enabled or disabled in the settings menu.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/1fd24e000b3bdae1aecb195ba389e2d7b1fb0c6f.png[/img]

[*] Added two high-score challenge achievements: Greedy Grandmaster & Greedy Deity.
[/list]
[h3]【Numerical Changes】[/h3]
[list]
[*] The critical-related upgrades of Hyper Core were changed to [Purple Upgrades: Weakness Expert] and [Gold Upgrades: Weakness Master].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/324290d2ef265496266bed368ad9dfa367875c15.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/94dc771c47c6c0efc2241cfb59b21db38dc25354.png[/img]

[*] UAV's base damage reduced from 25 to 20.
[*] Plasma disc: The speed upgrade reduced from 60% to 50%. Fixed issue of Infinite Plasma disc increasing rotation speed and radius.
[*] Purple Weapon Upgrade: Charging.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/f7dabbea030c24d3ced75584b482a6a30675517d.png[/img]

[*] Purple Weapon Upgrade: Air Cooling (requires the mod [Overcharge] to unlock).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/b50bec216facc5e30551c65d4dd205d814a1aded.png[/img]

[*] Heat Efficiency Upgrade increased from 20% to 25%, Cooling Upgrade increased from 20% to 25% (requires the mod [Overcharge] to unlock).
[*] Shotgun's impact force increased from 1 to 2, Laser Gun's impact force decreased from 2 to 1.
[*] Rocket Launcher's initial explosion radius increased from 192 to 250, penetration and bounce upgrades now have a level 2 cap.
[*] Weakened initial and upgraded attributes of Guardian.
[*] Melee mod effectiveness range increased by 75%, and can cover Plasma disc's area.
[*] Cluster Bomb, Incendiary Bomb, and Nuclear Bomb's damage gradually increases over time.
[*] Nuclear Bomb's explosion center can instantly kill common enemies, elites and bosses are immune to that but will receive significant damage.
[*] Vulcan's initial range increased by 100%.
[*] Ion Shield now starts with 0.5 seconds of invulnerability.
[*] Dash invulnerability time increased to 0.3 seconds.
[*] Glass Cannon capacity changed to 6, and damage increase changed to 20% per level.
[*] Overload's damage bonus effect is now calculated separately as a multiplication.
[*] Reborn skill can now instantly kill common monsters.
[/list]
[h3]【Adjustments】[/h3]
[list]
[*] The "Equipment Quantity Limit" feature has been moved to the equipment configuration interface, allowing different limits to be set for each configuration.
[*] Mercenary remains now can yield G Crystals.
[*] Elite monsters now drop Large G Crystals, while boss monsters drop Super G Crystals.
[*] Upgrade and Hyper Core interfaces now display player's equipment information.
[*] Added death lens focus effect.
[*] Optimized explosion effect brightness.
[*] The Landing Pod now turns on lights at night to illuminate surroundings.
[*] Changed the sound effect for monster deaths.
[/list]
[h3]【Optimizations】[/h3]
[list]
[*] Optimized blood decal performance.
[*] Optimized damage number performance.
[*] Optimized performance of certain special effects.
[/list]
[h3]【Fixed Issues】[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the weapon level wasn't displayed in the multiplayer equipment interface.
[*] Fixed navigation error of controllers when clicking the Titan Mech.
[*] Fixed cursor jumping issue in challenge mission interface.
[*] Fixed fire rate display issue in equipment interface.
[*] Max resolution setting now adheres to desktop resolution limit.
[*] Fixed the incorrect cursor issue after looting remains.
[*] Fixed issue where players with auto-shoot enabled can't automatically shoot after respawn.
[*] Fixed certain controller issues.
[*] Fixed the issue where Dash's invulnerability would cancel Ion Shield's invulnerability.
[*] Fixed the issue where penetration would cause extra damage in specific situations.
[*] Fixed the problem where changing key bindings wouldn't sync with the prompts for airdrops and hyper cores.
[/list]
[h3]【Others】[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added photosensitive warning.
[/list]

[h3]Future Major Update Preview:[/h3]
[b]During Steam SHMUP Fest on September 26th, we will post another major update. At that time, we will introduce a brand-new combat mechanism. This will allow different equipment to be combined, creating even more powerful ultimate gear. Furthermore, we will continue to develop additional weapon combinations and upgrade options.[/b]

notes.title: "Greedland" Now Available! Demo Saves Inheritable
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I am Vamp, and after nearly three years of development, the game is finally available. I hope you all will enjoy it.

At the same time, I deeply apologize for the significant hardware compatibility bugs that have arisen in our local dual player mode. We are currently working urgently to fix this and expect it to be up and running before August 11, could be just tomorrow, bust still, sorry again.

"Greedland" has always offered a rich content since its demo phase, ensuring several hours of enriching experience. With this early access version, you can inherit your demo saves, and it flawlessly supports the SteamDeck, offering a lot of updates, including new weapons, enemies, modes, local dual player, and more!

[h1]Greedland[/h1]

The early access version will offer 6 playable characters, each with unique attributes and skills, leading to diverse battle styles. For example, the Vanguard is a bit tanker, with the skill "Ice Ring" offering significant control, making it ideal for beginners.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/d35b9b896a02ecef5d9b28ce8644c34b2f6b2eb4.gif[/img]

On the other hand, the Ranger has a more agile but vulnerable body, and the skill "E-Overload" provides a potent burst, suitable for more aggressive players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/99b751bb15b3d1b88ac0af66c34dd009d5587259.jpg[/img]

"Greedland" also offers up to 12 primary weapons and includes an enhancement system for each weapon, making the impact of weapon choice more direct. There are assault rifles for hit-and-run tactics, flamethrowers for AOE crowd control, and chain-damage explosive orbs. You could say that changing your weapon in "Greedland" is like changing games entirely, with each offering a unique battle experience and strategic choices.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/928429249f5558af50cfeb7d1bc9f9e94aeaf544.gif[/img]

Additionally, "Greedland" provides 10 selectable auxiliary equipment, 35 skill chips, and over 300 in-game upgrade options, providing almost infinite combinations for each adventure!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/99b751bb15b3d1b88ac0af66c34dd009d5587259.jpg[/img]

You can continuously strengthen your primary weapon, sweeping through enemy hordes with powerful basic attacks, or you could repeatedly enhance various secondary weapons, creating magical damage combos, or you could constantly add survival skills, surviving crises with a strong survival ability. In "Greedland," even if the same character wields the same weapon, choosing a different upgrade path can significantly change your combat style.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/6f7db657a30451192134fcbbe9d7a9ae2686ad92.gif[/img]

As you advance in the game, you will gradually move away from chaotic random upgrades and will need to use strategy, choosing the right weapon to pair with crucial skills, and developing your own combat patterns. This is not only rewarding but also essential for overcoming difficult campaigns.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/c79d5f0bed7753264a7ab712b060a0452b5c92f2.gif[/img]

During the early access phase, "Greedland" will offer 3 large maps, each with 10 stages. These stages are split into three difficulty levels, ensuring all players have a balanced gaming experience and gradually progress through the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/94cc4e9c481ac88bd68c4847804f72858d693326.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/c51b2a8b3093d168db225a334635997937c52e82.png[/img]

Each stage has unique enemy combinations, and there's a fair amount of randomness. Especially challenging bosses will give players a big "surprise," and the early access version adds a powerful boss atop the already abundant enemies, providing the most thrilling combat sensation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/094250185c37929ff59f3f7b162317fbed173be3.gif[/img]

Furthermore, players will receive numerous tasks throughout the game. As you progress, the tasks get increasingly difficult. Completing these tasks will unlock many special rewards and encourage players to try new things, making this both an interesting challenge and a surprising exploration.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/3e8423c83498cb13488880701f101abd58640be7.png[/img]

"Greedland" is developed with Unreal Engine 5, so the visual quality is outstanding. Each monster is finely and vividly detailed, and when they swarm you like a tidal wave, you will feel the pressure. In contrast, using cool weapons to wipe out hordes of enemies provides an unparalleled exhilarating sensation, as if you're playing "Bug Warriors Unleashed"!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/167eff7bd26ad04c31f1b83b2de9a39f58703166.gif[/img]

"Greedland" is still in its early access phase, and content will continue to be updated, including more enemies and levels. New gameplay modes like Endless Mode and Online Co-op will be added, so stay tuned!

notes.title: Survive in an Alien Bullet-Hell: Greedland Will Be Released on Steam August 4th!

Greedland is a survivor-like game with roguelite elements. Taking control of a space mercenary, players must survive waves of enemies while gathering resources to unlock and upgrade weapons and skills, so they can gain an advantage in the face of greater challenges.

Greedland is coming to Early Access on Steam at GMT+8 18:00 on August 4th! The EA version will introduce a ton of new content and game features.
Add Greedland to your wishlist now for more!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2218400/Greedland/

For survivor-like games, the co-op mode can often bring 1+1>2 happiness. In the EA version, Greedland will launch local co-op mode, and now you can destroy monsters with your partners! Endless mode will also be launched simultaneously, try how long you can survive!

[h1]About Greedland:[/h1]
Greedland is a survivor-like top-down shooting game. Players will play the role of interstellar mercenaries, using powerful weapons and skilled operations to eliminate waves of enemies coming in like waves. The addition of Roguelite elements brings a fresher experience to Greedland.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/b2f582c0795fa122cd177a59d0e2ccd6531b5d62.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/d7f9e858f0ee496908f1e97f74b098d809a5a6b9.png[/img]

With up to 12 main weapons, and the weapon you choose directly affects your gameplay experience. Whether it's a Submachine Gun for rapid, on-the-move firefights, a Flamethrower for crowd control and AoE damage, or a Plasma Thrower for chain damage explosions, every weapon swap is a game-changer, morphing combat dynamics and strategic decisions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/32d075e79b52a621025e1b62fc7c576b410f3b55.gif[/img]

You can continuously enhance your main weapon, relying on devastating regular attacks to wipe out hordes of enemies. Alternatively, you can also focus on enhancing auxiliary equipments, creating unique combos, or prioritize inproving survival abilities to withstand numerous crises. 
Even with the same character and weapon, choosing different upgrade paths during battle will greatly change your approach to combat.

The longer you survive, the more enjoyable you have to kill.
Regularly provide support items that are beneficial to player survival and combat to help you survive longer.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43223334/a025251acae07ec710e43259df96485cb64bce3e.png[/img]
